crossRefs.note: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
Yahweh spoke to Manasseh, and to his people; but they didn’t listen.
Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand…
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…
Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…

translations.web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
translations.bsb: For God speaks in one way and in another, yet no one notices.
translations.kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth
translations.asv: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, though man regardeth it not.
